intro: Huldar is a dwarven teamster stationed along the southern road of Loch Modan, near the shores of the lake. Tasked with hauling vital blast powder to the dig site in the south, his delivery caravan faces relentless harassment from local threats and Dark Iron saboteurs.

p: Hauling explosives through Loch Modan is no simple trade route. Huldar was tasked with driving wagonloads of mining blast powder down toward the southern excavation site, where dwarven archaeologists and prospectors desperately need supplies. However, the wilderness roads have become increasingly hazardous. With local wildlife, troggs, and Dark Iron infiltrators lurking near the lake's southern bend, Huldar finds himself stranded by his damaged wagon, relying on wandering travelers to safeguard the remaining powder kegs and ensure the shipment reaches the dig.
